title: Plain block façade outline
subject: Art & Design
unit: Summer 1: Architecture: Hundertwasser and Zaha Hadid
source: Written for art/y9 lesson 16 (Plain block façade outline (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 16: Hundertwasser's buildings revisited. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

blocks.text: This is a plain block: straight lines, identical windows, grey. Redraw it in Hundertwasser's style: organic lines, every window different, colour and plants (tree tenants, roof gardens).

panels.title: His ideas
points: Nature and people should live together
Each window should express its resident

keywords.def: Hundertwasser's term for trees growing from buildings

questions.q: Redraw a plain window in Hundertwasser's style.
questions.a: A wavy, irregular window with colour and a plant.

questions.q: Redesign the façade of an ordinary block (from the pupil PDF) in Hundertwasser's style with organic lines, varied windows and plants; colour it; upload.
Extend: write two sentences on whether you agree with his ideas.

options: a tree growing from a building
questions.a: A) a tree growing from a building. Trees as residents.

questions.q: Think again: Why might someone dislike straight lines in buildings?
questions.a: Hundertwasser felt straight lines were unnatural; he preferred the irregular, living lines of nature.
